name: Wishpower UP! Down with Voracity!
introduction:
The Voracity's corrosion has spread across this world. Enemies afflicted with Voracity Corrosion become far more ferocious and dangerous.
● Defeat monsters corrupted by the Voracity to help Aha gather Wishpower.
● Each monster defeated yields 4/10/40 Wishpower based on the monsters' corrosion level.
● As Wishpower increases, Aha will grant the Player power, which will help the Player better defeat enemies in Stages affected by Voracity Corrosion.
● During the event, defeating Corroded monsters in Treasures Lightward for the first time will grant more Wishpower.
